# Feature Implementation Prompt

Implement a feature in this repository using existing architecture and style.

## Inputs
- Feature name:
- Route or screen:
- Data model changes (if any):
- UX acceptance criteria:
- Test scope:

## Requirements
1. Follow standalone Angular patterns and existing feature-folder conventions.
2. Use inject() field injection only.
3. Keep route page as container and move UI into focused child components when needed.
4. Add all user-facing text via translation keys and update en/nl dictionaries.
5. Add or update tests for changed behavior.
6. Keep changes minimal and aligned with current design tokens and UX rhythm.

## Deliverables
- Implementation files changed.
- Translation keys added/updated.
- Test changes and execution summary.
- Risks or follow-up items.
